headline: Lotte Global Logistics will test humanoid robots in warehouses across South Korea over the next five years under a government-backed project.
score_reason: Real project with partners, but a pilot with no scale-up date.
importance_line: Korean warehouse work could gradually involve humanoids and the project aims to cut dependence on foreign robots, but it is a pilot programme and the report gives no date for full-scale use.
summary: Chosunbiz reports that Lotte Global Logistics, working with Yujin Robot, CISO and the Korea Electronics Technology Institute, was selected for a project running to March 2031 to build a Korean physical-AI model for humanoid robots and pilot them on six warehouse tasks such as sorting, picking and packing. Lotte Himart will join as a customer.
notes: Read via Chosunbiz because the Global Sources page returned 429; Global Sources 2028 deployment date not confirmed.
